findings: Global full-frame pixel statistics are used as depth null; not per-object whole and not a background-only mask.
Uniform deduplicated priors cancel candidate score differences; H0 has no extra prior votes.
Shared role/source edges cancel; missing pre histories and paired post quality are genuine evidence limits.
Large WLS extrapolation bias and parameter variance cannot be repaired only by process calibration.
Previous squared residual/time rate has correct units but double-counts noisy targets and parameter error; short-step errors do not identify long-gap drift.
Student-t4 variance=2*scale^2: depth Gaussian-MAD variance proxy is passed as scale without geometry covariance/2 convention.
New local-level increment diffusion is a biased consistency proxy, not physical uncertainty calibration.
Observed current-object query-inclusive KDE is a proper conditional plug-in null, not independently fitted likelihood or calibrated Bayes posterior.
Four-arm joint mean+null repair can test native tracking improvement; it cannot isolate which of the two repaired components caused any gain.
scope: All19 q per raw and v2; no raw RGB/GT/pixel reread, no replay or threshold search
